policy: leading-zero digit strings written as ="..." text form; minimal quoting; CRLF
bug_report: The nightly export to the ERP is corrupting rows - any product description containing a comma spills into the next column and shifts everything after it. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py. Fix the export so field values arrive in the ERP intact, without breaking existing behaviour.
non_guessable: decision lives in git history (a documented commit), broken by a misleading 'perf' regression commit; git log/blame is the shortcut
decision_subject: fix: make the ERP CSV export round-trip every field value exactly
decision_rationale: Part numbers with leading zeros were coming back stripped after the ERP import - "00042" became "42" and broke SKU lookups; plain quoting does not stop the coercion. Digit-only values with a leading zero are now written in the Excel-style text form ="00042", the only form the ERP import keeps verbatim. Everything else uses minimal quoting (quote a field only when it contains a comma, quote, or newline; double embedded quotes), and rows end with CRLF because the ERP parser rejects bare newlines. Invariant: the import round-trips every field byte-for-byte.
